about.58_byte_block_shared_by_airpods_3_: 58-byte block shared by AirPods 3 and Pro: Q15 quaternion [20:26], gyroscope [26:32] (~0.122 °/s per unit), acceleration [38:44], gravity [44:50] (~1000 = 1 g).
about.airpods_pro_2_sensordatawx_protoco: AirPods Pro 2: SensorDataWX protocol (protobuf, 0x100000) — ACTIVITY(14) then DEVMOTION6(16).
about.apple_remotehid_rtbuddy_channel_0x: Apple RemoteHID (RTBuddy channel 0x800): each sensor is a virtual HID device. Sub-packet header u32: deviceID (7 bits), length (10 bits), type (3 bits).
about.hostconnect_00_gg_00_00_00_02_00_0: HostConnect 00 gg 00 00 | 00 02 00 00 → the AirPods publish their sensors (DeviceConnect + plist + HID descriptor).
about.l2cap_mtu_at_672_bytes_linux_defau: L2CAP MTU: at 672 bytes (Linux default), AirPods 3 hide their sensors; at 2582 (like iOS) they publish devmotion6, accel, gyro, cma, kadabra.
about.setreport_feature_1_report_interva: SetReport feature 1 = Report Interval (µs) on devmotion6 → motion stream up to ~200 Hz.
about.user_acceleration_38_44_gravity_re: User acceleration [38:44] (gravity removed, ~1000 = 1 g): noise ≈ 0.02 g at rest — clean enough for Glide mode with a reset to zero at every stop.
about.what_we_learned_from_reverse_engin: What we learned from reverse engineering — details in REVERSE_ENGINEERING.md.

garmin.latency_80_ms_of_batching_in_the_: Latency: ~80 ms of batching in the watch, plus 130 ms median (240 ms p95) of BLE bursts.

garmin.so_it_measures_tilt_direction_of_: So it measures tilt (direction of gravity), not rotation around the vertical. Rendering at 120 Hz smooths out the 25 Hz steps.
garmin.tap_strength_g_threshold_for_a_ta: Tap strength<small>g; threshold for a tap on the watch</small>
garmin.the_watch_accepts_only_one_ble_cl: The watch accepts only one BLE client: disconnect it from the phone first (phone Bluetooth off).
garmin.the_watch_link_uses_the_garmin_bl: The watch link uses the garmin-ble library, installed separately: .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-garmin.txt, then restart MousePods. garmin-ble is licensed under AGPL-3.0 (MousePods stays under Apache-2.0): see docs/GARMIN.md.
garmin.the_watch_streams_only_the_accele: The watch streams only the accelerometer in real time: 3 samples every 120 ms (24.9 Hz), 12 bits, ±8 g. No live gyroscope.
garmin.tilting_the_wrist_moves_the_curso: Tilting the wrist moves the cursor, a double tap on the watch clicks. Accelerometer only, 25 Hz (BLE service 16).

gestures.action_window_seconds_after_the: Action window<small>seconds after the double teeth click</small>
gestures.chewing_impulses_within_3_s_to_: Chewing: impulses<small>within 3 s to suspend teeth clicks</small>
gestures.double_max_gap_seconds_between_: Double: max gap<small>seconds between the two clicks</small>
gestures.head_and_jaw_a_double_teeth_cli: Head and jaw. A double teeth click opens a 2 s window; outside the window, no action is run.
gestures.jaw_clench_experimental_sustain: Jaw clench (experimental)<small>sustained weak vibration > 0.6 s; not verified on AirPods</small>
gestures.mouth_a_word_silently_while_hol: Mouth a word silently while holding the button. ~10 takes per word. “Evaluate” measures accuracy (leave-one-out) and compares it with chance (500 permutations): if p > 0.05, the IMU doesn't pick up the word and it shouldn't be used.
gestures.raw_imu_200_hz_hid_accel_gyro_t: Raw IMU ~200 Hz<small>HID accel + gyro; the mouse (devmotion6) drops to 50 Hz while gestures are active</small>
gestures.repeat_the_gesture_10_times_the: Repeat the gesture 10 times: the threshold is set to 60 % of your median peak. Relaxed detection and no actions during calibration.
gestures.require_activation_double_teeth: Require activation<small>double teeth click before each action</small>
gestures.sideways_jaw_slide_not_detected: Sideways jaw slide: not detected (no plausible signal identified) — reserved, experimental. The left/right side of a teeth click is unknown until click_side_axis is set.

js.lb.adaptive_hint: the adaptive threshold stays active: it rises when you talk or chew
js.lb.desc_moves: Nod, shake, tilts left/right, look up/down × 5 (≈ 2 min). Detection rate per gesture with the current thresholds.
js.lb.desc_teeth: Incisors, left molars, right molars × soft / medium / strong, 8 clicks each (≈ 4 min). Measures the strength per level and per tooth group, the left/right separability, and proposes a threshold.
js.lb.desc_words: EXPERIMENTAL — 5 words mouthed without voice × 10 (≈ 2 min 40). Trains silent_speech (DTW) and measures the accuracy against chance (500 permutations). p > 0.05: nothing proves that the IMU picks up the words.
js.lb.eval_running: Evaluation running (DTW + 500 permutations, a few dozen seconds)…
js.lb.res_noise: rest noise p90 {p90} / p99 {p99} m/s², {n} impulse(s) at rest
js.lb.sep_hint: Honest score: each click is classified without having been used for training. Chance = always answering the most frequent class; p = probability of doing at least as well by chance (binomial).
js.lb.warn_disabled: Gestures disabled: enable them (Gestures page) to receive the raw IMU.
js.lb.warn_dm6: Raw IMU missing: 50 Hz only, clicks poorly measured.
js.motion.bias_wait: Waiting for a moment of stillness…
